Large-scale plane of the fort showing the position, type and size of guns, and the location of "torpedoes," roads, buildings, rifle pits, telegraph station, vegetation, drainage, and hachures. Four cross sections of ramparts are given in the inset.

Large-scale plane of the fort showing the position, type and size of guns, and the location of "torpedoes," roads, buildings, rifle pits, telegraph station, vegetation, drainage, and hachures. Four cross sections of ramparts are given in the inset. This plan is similar in content to two printed maps entitled Plan and sections of Fort Fisher carried by assault by the U.S. forces . . . and Sketch of vicinity of Fort Fisher . . . For complete descriptions of printed maps see entry nos. 310 and 314. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale ca. 1:1500. Library of Congress.
